% A document built with its config, or tex8web itself, in a folder with a

\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\newcommand\term[1]{\emph{#1}}
\newcommand\keyword[1]{\textbf{#1}}
\newcommand\norm[1]{\lVert #1\rVert}
\begin{document}
\section{Spaces}\label{sec:spaces}
A \term{config word} and a \keyword{sibling word}.
\begin{equation}\label{eq:norm}
  \norm{x} \le 1
\end{equation}
See section~\ref{sec:spaces} and \eqref{eq:norm}.
